name: Delete Duplicate Products for WooCommerce
author: Luis Peel

sections.description:
This plugin provides a comprehensive solution for managing duplicate products in WooCommerce. With enhanced features for bulk actions and image management, you can:

  • Find Duplicates: Automatically detect duplicate products based on title or SKU
  • Filter Products: View products by status (Published, Draft, Trash, or All)
  • Bulk Actions:
    • Delete products permanently
    • Move products to trash
    • Change products to draft status
  • Image Management:
    • Remove featured images
    • Remove gallery images
    • Remove all product images
  • Enhanced Interface:
    • Pagination controls
    • Items per page selection
    • Status filtering
    • Group by Title or SKU

Key Features:

  • Intuitive and user-friendly interface
  • Bulk actions for efficient management
  • Advanced filtering options
  • Comprehensive image management
  • Safe product status handling
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce version
sections.installation:
Using WordPress Plugin Installer

  1. Go to the “Plugins” section in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Delete Duplicate Products for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the ZIP file to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory
  3. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu
sections.faq:
Can I recover products after moving them to trash?

Yes, products moved to trash can be restored from the WordPress trash section.

Does the plugin delete images from the media library?

Yes, when using the image removal features, the images are permanently deleted from the media library.

Can I filter products by multiple criteria?

Yes, you can combine status filters with title/SKU grouping to find specific duplicates.
